notes: S003.N1. The typescript continues the bitorsor example and then begins the underlined Structure section. Both the manuscript page number and the separate archive number are 2. The latter is a comment only. The visible grammatical phrase la ``champ’’, capital M in bi-Modules, and unaccented cochaine are preserved. No named contributor is established for the pen additions.

S003.N2. The source defines pi_0(C) from object classes and pi_1(C) from automorphisms of the unit, then gives two maps Aut(1_C) to Aut(X). The visible phrase l’automorphisme rho(X) de 1_C is retained. A targeted type check shows that composing these group isomorphisms, one inversely, gives an automorphism of the group Aut(1_C), not directly of the object 1_C. The wording may be abbreviated or a slip; the transcription does not repair it. This check assumes the source’s isomorphism assertion and does not independently prove it.

S003.N3. The page states commutativity of pi_1(C), the pi_0(C)-module structure, the relation between the pentagon and a 3-cocycle, and the change f to f+dg under a changed choice of phi. These are source claims carried as background here. Neither the phrases On prouve and On vérifie nor the visual comparison constitute a proof check of those assertions.

S003.N4. Three independent readings were compared. Main crops settle old ot in auto-équivalences, old t in bitorseurs, cancelled de 1, two old letters ah in the second cochaine, and old p in correspondants. Seven uncertain loci remain. The extra impression under the first r of correspondants is newly recorded without identifying it securely. The pentagon connector is an insertion hook with its text attached after d’associativité, not an independent diagram; the page’s one mathematical diagram has two rightward arrows.

S003.N5. The final text records the corrected group index 0 as handwritten over a typed 1. The interlinear P is typed, with a pen caret. Every phi occurrence, both baseline typed x separators, both short prose hyphens, quotation shapes and underline extents were inspected in main-reader crops. Two initial main crops missed or clipped their intended loci and were replaced by adjusted tight crops; all derived files are retained.
